subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter needed to close procurement

Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter for procurement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Acme needs our SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12-month audit period (they asked for Jan 1, 2025 – Dec 31, 2025), and if that exact period isn't available they require a bridge letter that covers the gap. They indicated a hard procurement deadline of Feb 22 to get the reports uploaded to their vendor portal — otherwise the deal will slip to next quarter.

Attached is the vendor request form and a redacted PO for reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II for that window or whether you can provide a bridge letter? If we can get confirmation + documents by Tues (Feb 17) it would keep things moving.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Senior Security Manager, Acme Corp

Rishi — looping you in. Acme is pushing for SOC 2 Type II for Jan–Dec 2025 or a bridge letter to cover any audit-period mismatch. They have a procurement cutoff next week (Feb 22).

As context: this is a high-priority expansion (deal ACME-2026-0421) — Jordan, FYI. Can security confirm:
- Do we have a Type II report that covers the requested window?
- If not, can we provide a bridge letter / auditor attestation that will satisfy Acme's vendor team?

Thanks,

marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -08:00

Marissa — thanks for the ping and for the clear timeline. Quick update from security & compliance:

1) Current state: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period Mar 1, 2024 – Feb 28, 2025 (audit issued March 2025). That does not align with Acme's requested Jan 1–Dec 31, 2025 window.

2) Options to unblock:
   • If the customer will accept our March 2024–Feb 2025 Type II, we can provide that report immediately.
   • If the customer insists on a Type II covering calendar 2025, we do not have one yet — audit for 2025 is in-flight with AuditSphere and won't be finalized until mid-April.
   • We can provide a bridge letter / attestation that explains the audit coverage, lists compensating controls in place since Mar 2025, and references the auditor engaged (AuditSphere). Legal (Lauren) and I will need to review the exact language; the typical turnaround for an internal-approved bridge letter is 48–72 hours once we have a PO and a named procurement contact.

3) Next steps I recommend:
   - Lauren: can you review the attached draft-bridge-template.docx and confirm any legal risk/required phrasing?
   - Markus: need your quick confirmation on the control coverage statements for Q1–Q4 2025 in the attached soc2-audit-summary-2025.csv.
   - Marissa/Jordan: please confirm whether Acme will accept either the March-2024–Feb-2025 Type II (fastest) OR whether a bridge letter is required. If bridge letter is needed, we will aim for a 72-hour internal turnaround and will need a single procurement contact (name + email) and signed PO.

I have attached the draft bridge template and a short audit-period summary to this message. I can draft the attestation language and circulate for signatures this afternoon.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Rishi is preparing a bridge-letter draft and expects to circulate an internal-ready version within ~72 hours pending Legal signoff. Rishi / Lauren — can we confirm the earliest date you can get an approved bridge letter? I need to provide Acme with a firm ETA so they can decide whether to accept the current report versus waiting for the bridge.

@Alice — would Acme accept either: 1) the March-2024–Feb-2025 Type II now, or 2) a bridge letter + the March-2024–Feb-2025 report as supplemental evidence? Please reply with your preferred option and procurement contact for the PO submission.

Appreciate the urgency — I will keep pressure on our side to meet the Feb 22 window if possible.

Best,
